9:55.text: So let not their wealth or their children impress you. Allāh only intends to punish them through them in worldly life and that their souls should depart

9:56.text: And they swear by Allāh that they are from among you while they are not from among you; but they are a people who are afraid.

9:57.text: If they could find a refuge or some caves or any place to enter
, they would turn to it while they run heedlessly.

9:58.text: And among them are some who criticize you concerning the
charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry.

9:59.text: If only they had been satisfied with what Allāh and His Messenger gave them and said, "Sufficient for us is Allāh; Allāh will give us of His bounty, and
His Messenger; indeed, we are desirous toward Allāh,"
[it would have been better for them]

9:60.text: Zakāh expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed for it
and for those in debt and for the cause of Allāh and for the
by Allāh. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

9:61.text: And among them are those who abuse the Prophet and say, "He is an ear."
an ear of goodness for you that believes in Allāh and believes the believers and
a mercy to those who believe among you." And those who abuse the Messenger of Allāh - for them is a painful punishment.
